title: 紧凑对拉序列
description: 木版画呈现近距离对拉手点与低脚点构成的紧凑姿态。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original woodcut-style illustration shows a fictional adult solving a compact opposition sequence close to the base of an indoor bouldering wall. Two broad side-facing handholds sit at different chest-level heights, while visible positive footholds let the climber shift weight across a small triangular volume. Both feet remain engaged and the move is deliberate rather than explosive. Use a low oblique wide view that includes the whole body and continuous crash mat stretching across the foreground. Carved black contours, warm ivory grain, and limited vermilion accents create strong shapes. The adult wears opaque practical clothes. No lettering, brands, dangerous height, leaps, or exaggerated musculature.
